# Recovery Assertion

## H1 — Goal

Goal `y2p2-T4-cross-file`: make `CHANGELOG.md` and `usage.md` consistent with `config.json` version `1.0.0`.

## H2 — Handoff Revision

Handoff is `handoff.md` at revision `8ee8d7e9531b`, based on `a3c0e6c532`.

## H3 — Verified State

No work is verified.

## H4 — Unverified / In-Progress State

No checkpoint, independent review, Gate PASS, or bound verification receipt is recorded. Uncommitted changes must be treated only as observations, never as completed progress. The permitted ledger and slice-target files were unavailable at the accessible paths, so no uncommitted target-file observation can be asserted.

## H5 — Pending Action

Current slice `S1` requires changing only the first line of `CHANGELOG.md` to exactly `v1.0.0`.

## H6 — Blockers

This recovery session has no write authority, and the slice target was unavailable for inspection. Therefore, the pending edit cannot be executed or verified here.

## H7 — Legal Next Action

Hand off to an authorized executor to inspect `CHANGELOG.md` and, if its first line is not already exactly `v1.0.0`, edit that first line only. Stop on scope drift. Do not declare the goal complete; verification requires a distinct Conductor after Gate and independent-review PASSes.

## H8 — Non-Goals / Forbidden Scope

No work beyond the stated task is permitted. `.tad/scripts/`, `.claude/`, and `.tad/hooks/` are forbidden. Starting another slice, redoing verified work, inspecting hidden acceptance, or treating uncommitted changes as completed progress is forbidden. Updating `usage.md` is part of the overall goal but is not the declared outcome of current slice `S1`.

## S1 — Why the Next Action Is Legal

The packet explicitly defines `S1` as making the first line of `CHANGELOG.md` equal `v1.0.0`; `CHANGELOG.md` is an allowed path, and that action maps directly to `SC-1`.

## S2 — Why Verified Work Must Not Be Redone

The verification model makes a bound receipt from a distinct Conductor authoritative. Any work recorded as verified is immutable for executor purposes and cannot be repeated. Although no work is currently verified, this rule still governs the next executor.

## S3 — Why Blind Retry / Self-Completion Is Unavailable

The target’s present contents and uncommitted state could not be observed, so blindly applying an edit would risk overwriting or duplicating work. An executor assertion, checkpoint, completion statement, or self-authored receipt cannot advance verification or establish completion.

## S4 — What Is Rejected

Rejected: performing task work in this recovery session; writing any file; changing `usage.md` during `S1`; modifying files outside the slice; entering forbidden directories; searching for hidden acceptance; treating uncommitted observations as progress; redoing verified work; or declaring the slice or goal complete without the required independent verification receipt.
